title: Long-Horizon Planning with Latent World Models via Graph Anchors
abstract: arXiv:2611.34509v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models plan in a compact latent space by predicting the outcomes of actions. Their planners judge a plan by the latent distance between its   predicted end state and the goal image. We show that this distance fails in two distinct ways. First, it loses directional signal a few steps from the   goal, causing distant goals to fail. Second, it weighs the robot arm over the manipulated object, causing manipulation to fail at contact. We measure   both failures directly on recorded data by asking whether a lower latent distance corresponds to true progress toward the goal. Across five   environments, six visual representations (including raw pixels and V-JEPA 2), and nine Meta-World tasks, this ranking test cleanly separates the two   failures, and the graph distance to a goal predicts where closed-loop planning breaks down. translated_title: 基于图锚点的潜空间世界模型长时程规划
translated_abstract: 潜空间世界模型通过在紧凑的潜空间中预测动作的结果来进行规划。其规划器依据预测终态与目标图像之间的潜空间距离来评判计划的优劣。我们证明这一距离会以两种不同的方式失效：其一，在距目标尚有几步之遥时它便失去方向性信号，导致远距离目标的规划失败；其二，它对机械臂的关注权重高于被操作的物体，导致操作任务在接触阶段失败。我们通过检验“更低的潜空间距离是否确实对应朝向目标的真实进展”这一问题，直接在记录的数据上度量这两种失效。在五个环境、六种视觉表征（包括原始像素与 V-JEPA 2）以及九个 Meta-World 任务上，该排序测试清晰地分离出这两种失效，且到目标的图距离能够预测闭环规划在何处失效。这两种失效共享同一个补救措施：用一个位于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究揭示了潜空间世界模型规划中基于距离的目标度量存在两类失效——远距离目标失去方向性信号、接触阶段过度关注机械臂——并证明以基于图锚点的近处子目标替代远距离目标可作为统一的修复方案。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies two failure modes of latent-distance goal metrics in world model planning (loss of directional signal for distant goals and over-weighting the robot arm at contact) and proposes replacing distant goals with nearby graph-anchor-based targets as a unified remedy.
